reason: The cited evidence shows higher creep activation energy and lower creep displacement in some HEAs vs. pure W (E3, E4), but it does not directly demonstrate sluggish diffusion inhibiting dislocation climb, nor does it link this to enhanced dynamic recovery, a stable dislocation network, or improved toughness/plastic strain. The mechanism connecting sluggish diffusion to toughness is inferred rather than supported by the cited passages.
premises: Sluggish diffusion in HEAs inhibits vacancy-mediated dislocation climb
Sluggish diffusion limits atomic mobility at high temperatures
Inhibited climb enables enhanced dynamic recovery and a stable dislocation network
Stable dislocation network increases plastic strain and toughness relative to pure W
HEAs exhibit higher creep activation energy and lower creep displacement than pure W
